Cookie Policy

Last updated: January 2025

1. What Are Cookies

Cookies are small text files that are stored on your device (computer, smartphone, or tablet) when you visit a website. They help the website remember your preferences and improve your overall browsing experience.

2. How We Use Cookies

RO Service Support uses cookies for the following purposes:

  • To remember your form data during your session
  • To understand how visitors use our website
  • To improve website performance and user experience
  • To display relevant advertisements through Google Ads
  • To measure the effectiveness of our marketing campaigns

3. Types of Cookies We Use

  • Essential Cookies: Required for basic website functions.
  • Analytical Cookies: Help us understand how visitors interact with our site.
  • Marketing Cookies: Used to show relevant ads and track campaign performance.
  • Functional Cookies: Remember your preferences for a better experience.

4. Third-Party Cookies

We may use third-party services such as Google Analytics and Google Ads. These services may place their own cookies on your device to collect anonymous usage data. Please refer to their respective privacy policies for more information.

5. Managing Cookies

You can control and manage cookies through your browser settings. Most browsers allow you to block or delete cookies. However, please note that disabling cookies may affect the functionality of our website and your overall experience.

6. Consent

By continuing to use our website, you consent to the use of cookies as described in this Cookie Policy. If you do not agree, please disable cookies in your browser settings or discontinue using our website.

7. Changes to This Policy

We may update this Cookie Policy from time to time. Any changes will be posted on this page with a revised "Last updated" date. We recommend checking this page periodically.

8. Contact Us
